title: Preservation report
description: Returned by env_promote. The intellectual content of the profile: for every plane of the environment, exactly what happened to it. An implementation that reports "lost" for something it advertised in the object's guarantees fails conformance.

excluded.description: Paths deliberately not carried because they belong to the machine rather than the application. REQUIRED: an exclusion list that lives only in the implementer's source silently drifts from reality, and printing it is what makes the drift reviewable.

downtime_seconds.description: Measured, never estimated. If it was not measured, omit this field and report "unknown" — a number nobody took is worse than an absent one.

result.description: preserved: byte-identical or semantically identical. recreated: equivalent but rebuilt, e.g. processes restarted with the same argv and cwd. lost: not carried — MUST be declared, never omitted.
